notes: Entire chunk is Tencent TDR/TLV serialization codegen from PacketCode (TdrBuf.h + TdrBufUtil.cpp). Two families: (A) BINARY WIRE WRITERS (src TdrBuf.h, assert 'position <= length'): take (structPtr, TdrBuf* {base@0,pos@4,len@8}, presenceParam) and append bytes; helpers FUN_1010c0c0=put u8, FUN_1010c120=put u16, FUN_1010c190=put u32, FUN_1010c200(lo,hi)=put u64, FUN_1010bf70=reserve/begin 4-byte length slot, FUN_1010c2b0(ptr,len)=write string bytes, FUN_1010c3c0(len,savedPos)=patch back 4-byte length prefix, FUN_101150a0=put u8(alt). Strings are stored as [4-byte reserved len][chars...][NUL] then length patched. (B) TEXT/DebugFormat DUMPERS (src TdrBufUtil.cpp): take (structPtr, sink, indent, ctx) and emit human-readable field dump; helpers FUN_1024a140=emit indent/open-line, FUN_1024a290(sink,indent,ctx,name,fmt,val)=emit named scalar, FUN_1024a1e0(ctx,name,..)=open sub-struct, FUN_1024a230(ctx,name,idx,..)=open array element, FUN_1024a410(ctx,name,ptr)=emit string field, FUN_1024a3b0(ctx,name,len,..)=open byte-array, FUN_1010c010=sprintf to sink. Format DAT constants: DAT_11d9e0b4='%d'(signed), DAT_11d9f574='%u'(unsigned/dword), DAT_11d9f710=hex uint (' 0x%08x'-style, used for raw u32/byte arrays), DAT_11da0cf4='%f'(float), DAT_11da4eb8=struct-open '%s%c'. These dumpers do NOT switch on tags — the write/dump side is POSITIONAL; the tag>>4 field_id switching lives in the READ/deserialize functions documented in TLV_DOCS. So field_ids here come from the generated docs, not the code; protocolFields lists recovered struct offsets/types/order. Server relevance: binary writers must be reproduced byte-exact for S2C packets; DebugFormat dumpers are client-side logging only (no wire impact). Two real doc discrepancies found: TlvWeaponRecord and TlvWeaponStyleData are documented as scalar int32 but are actually fixed 20xu32 arrays (WeaponRecord additionally has a second 20xu32 weaponRecordTime array).
